items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: one of my classmates, Owens... So, I got to talking with Owens, my classmate, who was a trumpet player, and I said, I sure wish I could be in that band.

ctx.x: Anyway, he was very nice and he said I hope you can figure out something. He

went on, and he said, my goodness, I remember your brother here. Why in the world didn't Clarence make you get a horn before you came here or something. So we went on and one of my classmates, Owens--
Wait a minute. What was the band director's name again?
